answer: The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, released only after three unrelated confirmations, rewards vest against future work. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The pulse of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A sable of per-task receipts records who did what, and the kernel of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
